On this visit you compare museum interpretation with the voices of living communities.

The gallery, date, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Orientation and ethical framing
  • Gallery thematic study
  • Select object/story interpretation
  • Discussion on representing living communities

How the time is spent

  1. Orientation and ethical framing 20 min

  2. Gallery thematic study 35 min

  3. Select object/story interpretation 45 min

  4. Discussion on representing living communities 30 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
